The CONTACT who issued this grant from the external SPA (contact-side Grant Access). Written by the BFF only (field-secured); sprk_grantedby (systemuser) stays empty on such a grant. A contact may change or revoke only the grants it issued. unified-access-control-r2 task 140, owner C4 / Q2.

The id of the CONTACT who issued this grant, as text — written and cleared by the BFF in the same write as Granted By (Contact), so it survives that contact's deletion (the lookup's Delete cascade empties the lookup). Set while the lookup is empty means the issuing contact was deleted: the reconciliation job ends such an undated grant. Field-secured; BFF-written only. unified-access-control-r2 task 140, session 27 round 50 item 2.
